trigger_rules: The highest level any trigger reaches wins.
Two different Watch triggers in the same 24 hours make it an Incident.
Hard triggers go straight to Crisis: personal data exposed or suspected, an injury or credible safety report, a regulator, a lawsuit served, a misconduct allegation against a leader.

holding_statements.text: Our checkout is not working right now, so orders can't be placed on brightkettle.example. Our team is working on it. We are checking whether any orders already placed were affected, and we will email anyone whose order was. We will post the next update by {{next_update_time}} at brightkettle.example/updates and on our Facebook and Instagram pages.

holding_statements.legal: counsel must clear at time of use

sequencing: Named affected customers hear first, by email or text; when they can't be named, the website statement is their notice and goes first.
Social, partners and press wait for the website statement and link to or quote it.
The staff brief goes out in the same minutes as the first customer notice.
channel_playbook.website_rule: Organic Search plus Direct bring 54.8% of users (a third or more), so every website statement, at Incident and at Crisis, goes on the /updates page linked from the home page, not only on the affected page or on social.
